jobs_results.title: Senior Operations Steering Project Manager (M/F/D)
jobs_results.description:
Key responsibilities/What you do

Easy Living and Mobile Device, Appliances and Digital Risks (MDDR) is our Line of Business in charge of delivering services to our customers for daily life, such as: TeleAssistance/TeleHealth, rehabilitation, protection for devices and digital risks, and many more.

Global Easy Living & MDDR Operations are aiming to service customers in the most effective manner, delivering for quality and productivity indicators. Global Teams foster innovation, globalization, optimal performance management, and close monitoring of service delivery. They work with regional and local operations teams, bridging operations with global supporting functions, and acting as a single-point-of-contact to ensure higher harmonization and alignment with Group targets and standards.

The Senior Operations Steering Manager in Global Easy Living & MDDR Operations will be a key liaison agent to connect Operations and relevant global supporting functions (Performance Management... Workforce Management, Quality & Training, Fraud, Compliance, Transformation and others). He or She will ensure global strategies are steered and delivered in Operations in a harmonized and consistent way, and results are tracked centrally. By developing deep know-how on local operations needs and challenges, global standards, tools and methodologies, this manager will leverage global resources and adapt to the need of the various operational centers.
• Lead the deployment of data-driven optimization and transformation initiatives for Easy-Living & MDDR Operations, as an agent of change covering near 1000+ employees in multiple locations.
• Support the implementation of the new Operations structure in complete alignment with the strategy and close collaboration with other functions (LoBs, Transversal, functions, etc.), contributing positively to the overall success of Operations.
• Support Global Operations to implement the group standards and policies related to operations setup, including steering & governance, quality, operational excellence, and digital initiatives.

Key requirements/What you bring
• Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, insurance, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
• Minimum 8 years’ experience in Project Management, Operations background preferred.
• Knowledge of Operational Excellence methodologies (Lean six sigma).
• Proven record of Data Management skills, attention to detail, and ability to produce high quality reports and C-level deliverables.
• Advance knowledge of Office 365 package, including solid knowledge of Excel, PowerBI and other data visualization tools.
• Self-steering, highly autonomous and capable to plan and foresee expectations, potential risks or escalations, providing no-surprise regular visibility to Management.
• Experience leading Change with large communities, in collaboration with multiple teams, and stakeholders at all levels of the Organization.
• Strong ability to influence and build effective relationships at all levels of the business.
• English mandatory, German preferred, or other languages.

Key benefits/What we offer

Our employees play an integral part in our success as a business. We appreciate that each of our employees are unique and have unique needs, ambitions and we enjoy being a part of their journey.

We are there to empower and encourage you with your personal and professional development ensuring that you take control by offering a large variety of courses and targeted development programs. All that in a global environment where international mobility and career progression are encouraged. Caring for your health and wellbeing is key priority for us. This is why we build Work Well programs to providing you with peace of mind and give the flexibility in planning and arranging for a better work-life balance

45986 | Project Management | Professional | Non-Executive | Allianz Partners | Full-Time | Permanent

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

We at Allianz believe in a diverse and inclusive workforce and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, no matter where you are from, what you look like, who you love or what you believe in.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, disability or sexual orientation.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow

jobs_results.title: Data & AI Project Manager at Electronic Arts in Madrid
jobs_results.description:
EA inspires the world to play, and the Worldwide Localization Team makes that happen! We are accountable for delivering the high-quality localized versions of our titles to over 30 countries around the world. You will find a vibrant, multicultural environment with a great mixture of professionals. From software engineers, project managers, testers to audio, text and linguistic specialists, each employee has an important role to play. EA has built a cutting-edge Localization powerhouse that covers the needs for both current and next-generation platform.

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Data & AI Project Manager to join our dynamic team at Electronic Arts (EA). This role is key to driving our digital transformation efforts, as you'll be leading projects that leverage data and AI to enhance our gaming experiences and business outcomes.

Responsibilities:
• Develop, manage, and lead complex data and AI projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are delivered on... time and within scope and budget.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, data analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders, to define project objectives, deliverables, and timelines.
• Identify, assess, and manage potential project risks and obstacles, develop effective mitigation strategies, and maintain open communication with stakeholders.
• Effectively communicate project expectations, progress, and outcomes to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
• Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting the sharing of knowledge and expertise and driving the achievement of shared goals.
• Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of learning and sharing.

Qualifications:
• A PhD or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
• A minimum of 3 years of proven project management experience, focusing on data and AI-related projects.
• Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies, strongly emphasising Agile and Scrum, and knowledge of project management software, especially Jira.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and team-building skills, with a demonstrated ability to motivate and guide diverse teams.
• Ability to develop strong relationships with key stakeholders, successfully managing expectations and resolving conflicts.
• Strong strategic and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate potential issues and create effective solutions.
• Demonstrated leadership skills, with experience in mentoring.
• Interest in gaming is a big plus.

Preferred Skills:
• Certifications in Project Management (PMP, Prince2), Agile, or Scrum would be advantageous.
• Experience in the gaming industry would be a significant plus.
• Familiarity with data visualization and AI tools and platforms.

#LI-VEP1

The primary focus of this project will be to ensure alignment of systems across the Group as well as supporting the process changes entailed by the project.The most important tasks in the role are:Alignment with the various track leads in the project.Ongoing reporting to the Steering group.Documentation of progress, decisions, etc.You report to the Director of Product Management and... Project Portfolio. You can expect 10-20 annual travel days.You bring your strong international and digital project management experience into play when navigating among various stakeholders across the entire Group. You are most successful in the role when you listen to and understand different perspectives, but at the same time act upon and make decisions to secure that all projects are delivered according to the plan. To do so you use your excellent communication capabilities and your strong collaboration skills when working across borders and within different cultures in the Group.It is an advantage if you have:+5 years of experience as a Project Manager performing major international digital projects.Experience from an international role and from having worked with different cultures.Experience from reporting to a Steering group and from collaborating with many different stakeholders.Change management experience, as much of the work will be changing processes in large parts of the business.About Us | Become part of the development | Psychological Safety | "we walk the talk"Now is the perfect time to become part of Karnov Group! In Karnov Group, you will experience a company in rapid development, where the business is being rethought and digitized, and where we are continuously undergoing a transformation from a traditional publishing house to a modern information technology company. Karnov Group is a leading provider of critical information in the fields of law, tax, auditing, accounting, as well as environmental, health, and safety matters in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, France, Spain, and Portugal. Our solutions are based on reliable knowledge authored by experts and delivered through technology.Psychological Safety is a cornerstone that supports our cultural values. In our daily operations, we act in accordance with and live up to these values by simply "walk the talk". You therefore become part of an attractive work culture and a dynamic environment in an ambitious company with talented colleagues who support and respect each other. We believe that close collaboration across the entire company contributes to serving our customers in the best possible way.Finally, you will join a competent team and a centrally located workplace in Copenhagen — near Nørreport Station. With content provided by over 7,000 well-renowned authors and experts, Karnov Group delivers knowledge and insights, enabling more than 500,000 users to make better decisions, faster – every day. With offices in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, France, Spain and Portugal, Karnov Group employs around 1,300 people. The Karnov share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Mid Cap segment under the ticker "KAR". jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Company Overview:

If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!

Flowserve is an American multinational corporation and one of the largest suppliers of industrial and environmental machinery, from pumps and seals to valves, actuation and instrumentation, to energy recovery devices and hydraulic decoking systems, and more, our products help plants overcome the... toughest flow control challenges.

The Project Manager will plan, direct, and ensure the successful outcome of projects utilizing the assigned project teams, as well as standards, practices, and toolsets established within Flowserve. You will work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure all project activity is regularly reported to the client and performed as per agreed technical specifications and project terms and conditions.

Responsibilities :
• Demonstrate ownership and accountability for total project execution, performance, and safety (project initiation to project completion) on all assigned projects.
• Drive improved customer relationships through creating a work environment that is free of unfavorable circumstances or perceptions for either party, that meets or exceeds performance expectations of the customer.
• Ensure a "clean order" before commencement of work on an assigned project and utilize the change management system to control the scope of work and associated cost, throughout the life of the project.
• Coordinate activities of all matrix reports (per Project).
• Responsible for managing spending expectations on each assigned Project.
• Communicate to all concerned parties project milestones, status updates, as well as any existing or potential customer escalation issues. Follow the right escalation processes and take overall ownership of all reports.
• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements :
• BS or BA Degree in relevant field (engineering) and 0-5 years relevant experience
• Proficient English skills
• Adaptability, flexibility, and proactivity.
• Excellent presentation, oral and written communication skills, including meeting and workshop facilitation experience
• Team building, problem-solving, and conflict resolution skills
• Experience using Microsoft Office.

Nice to have:
• Experience in program/project management.
• Proven experience in risk and change management
• Greenbelt, Blackbelt or Lean training experience preferred
• Rotating equipment experience
• Excellent estimating, scheduling & budgeting skills

What we offer (among other benefits):
• Canteen 100% founded by the company
• Transportation services 100% founded by the company
• Flexible working time: 30 minutes ahead or behind
• Summer timetable (shorter working hours)
• Easy access to the facility with city bus (line 283 from Avenida Americas)
• Easy access to the facility by car: close to M21 motorway junction

Req ID : R-9263

Job Family Group : Engineering

Job Family : EN Engineering

EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans. Flowserve will also not discriminate against an applicant or employee for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing their pay or, in certain circumstances, the pay of their co-workers. Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access flowservecareers.com as result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an email to employment@flowserve.com. In order to quickly respond to your request, please use the words "Accommodation Request" as your subject line of your email. For more information, read the Accessibility Process

jobs_results.title: Special Project Implementation Manager
jobs_results.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Special Projects Implementation Manager

Barcelona or Croydon (Hybrid)

This is a hybrid position primarily based in Barcelona or Croydon. We're committed to your flexibility and wellbeing and our hybrid strategy currently requires two days a week in the office, giving you the option to work remotely for some of your working week. Find out more about our culture of flexible working.

We give you a world of potential

We are looking for an implementation manager to oversee the implementation of new systems for our company. We are seeking someone who is capable of establishing relationships with internal and external stakeholders and taking an analytical approach to problem solving. You possess the qualities of a formidable leader who is capable of exerting influence over decision-makers and managing multiple priorities at any given moment.

A role you will love

Responsible for overseeing and overseeing the customer onboarding process throughout the... organization.

Identifying strategies for enhancing the customer onboarding process and collaborating with the team to implement them.

Responsible for managing, assigning, and conducting onboarding meetings, creating project plans, and turning customer requirements into deliverable configurations.

Understanding customer context, overseeing customer goals, and providing product information to best serve those goals.

Providing education to customers and collaborating with the team to optimize their product setup for the most expeditious route to success.

Collaborating with the team and creating a process to identify and eliminate roadblocks in the way of customers' goals.

Enhancing product adoption and customer retention, while also fostering positive customer relationships that result in a loyal customer base.

Providing materials to assist customers in acquiring best practices to enhance their desired outcomes.

As required, get involved in ad hoc projects for the team and support the wider business.

What will you bring to the role?
• A minimum of two years of experience in customer onboarding, communications, customer service and support, sales, account management, or customer success. It is advantageous to possess customer success courses or training.
• A high level of emotional intelligence and empathy.
• Strong communication abilities and the ability to comprehend customer narratives to comprehend their perspective and devise viable resolutions to their issues.
• Strong analytical and goal-oriented mindset backed by basic-to-advanced project management skills.
• Ability to resolve customer support requests and maintain a positive, goal-driven customer relationship.
• Advanced IT&C knowledge and capabilities and ability to learn new software tools on the job.
• Experience migrating and integrating legacy systems to new software solutions in a way that best serves client and business goals..

#LI-KT1 #LI-Hybrid

ABOUT US

A company to be proud of

We're a global leader in financial administration with over 14,000 employees across more than 21 different countries. At Computershare, it's more than just a job, our open and inclusive culture means that we will help you to grow, to move forward and make the most of our world of opportunities.

A diverse and inclusive place to work

Computershare celebrate the diversity of our people, and we welcome applications from everyone. We believe that having a culture of inclusion is essential in delivering good results. Attracting, retaining, and developing a diverse workforce where employees feel valued, respected, and empowered allows people to reach their full potential. As a business this diversity helps us to better reflect and understand our customers' needs to allow us to drive better outcomes.

We are happy to accommodate individual needs during your application journey. If you require disability accommodations or adjustments, please email us at TalentAcquisition@computershare.com detailing your requirements and contact information.

Computershare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national or ethnic origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by applicable law

jobs_results.title: Project Manager for Rail Signalling
jobs_results.description:
Siemens Mobility is a separately managed company of Siemens. As a leader in transport solutions for more than 160 years, Siemens Mobility is constantly innovating its portfolio in its core areas of rolling stock, rail automation and electrification, turnkey systems, intelligent traffic systems as well as related services. With digitalization, Siemens Mobility is enabling mobility operators worldwide to make infrastructure intelligent, increase value sustainably over the entire lifecycle, enhance passenger experience and guarantee availability.
Mobility Management, Turnkey Projects & Electrification, Mainline Transport, Urban Transport and Customer Services. They have the know-how to make road traffic flow more smoothly and quickly, make trains more environmentally friendly and efficient, make train schedules and freight shipments more reliable. We work with our customers to develop optimal solutions to help overcome their challenges.

The Project Manager is the responsible for... executing the project in compliance with the given requirements.
Have the objective to ensure project success, customer satisfaction and professional stakeholder management.

Area of Responsibilities
• Acquisition and contract negotiation
• Project organization and management
• Project controlling and project reporting
• Contract management incl. claim management
• Stakeholder management
• Opportunity and risk management
• Organization and management of project team
• Communication and knowledge management
• Compliance within the Project
• HR Management

Main Tasks
Acquisition and order negotiation
• Participation in the sales / project initiation phase, by analyzing customer requirements and checking their technical feasibility and transferability into a bid or project cost plan
• Carry out or attend contract negotiations
• Ensure the use of Siemens products, where available and applicable
• Ensure compliance with the corresponding LoA process, where applicable
• Check the project costing for financial efficiency
• Involve the corresponding partners in the sales / project initiation phase
Project organization and management
• Ensure that the order entry calculation is done and documented
• Ensure that all plan elements (e.g. system structure, WBS, etc.) are taken into account in the sales / project initiation phase
• Handle all PM@Siemens-related plan elements and milestone results according to the project category
• Prepare and maintain the Siemens project management plan
• Manage the project within the defined financial targets (budget, target costing, target profit)
• Prepare the project manager target agreement
• Optimize project profitability and ensuring business success
• Implement procedures to resolve questions and problems (identification, analysis, measures and monitoring) with all relevant internal and external partners
• Involve Procurement at an early stage in line with the applicable Siemens procurement guidelines
• Plan the procurement strategy (in local Procurement entity) with the business manager and procurement department of the respective organizational units
• Ensure that all procurement activities comply with the applicable processes and regulations
• Select subcontractors / partners
• Select and involve subcontractors / partners in accordance with the defined criteria
• Monitor the performance of subcontractors / partners, escalate issues in good time (e.g. quality defects or problems in cooperation) and initiate appropriate measures in good time in the event of any non-conformities
• Initiate invoicing in accordance with project progress
• Organize acceptance testing and project handover to contracted partner(s)
• Define procedures and requirements for quality management (audits, quality seals, acceptance tests) in accordance with the applicable quality management regulations and standards
• Manage regular project review meetings and organize the milestone prerequisites
• Manage the acceptance of supplies and services, subject to quality checks
• Document all work results in line with the applicable standards
Project controlling and reporting
• Optimize the project cash flow and assets
• Ensure the regular controlling of finances and regular reporting on finances
• Ensure compliance with the IFRS (International Finance and Reporting Standards)
• Continuously monitor project status, taking the IFRS into consideration, identify any non-conformities in good time and initiate specific counter measures where applicable
• Identify and minimize non-compliance costs
• Notify customers, management and the project team at an early stage in the event of any non-conformities
Contract management incl. claim management
• With international (cross-border) projects: Synchronize the contract structure with the tax action plan and delegation concept
• Identify, drive, defend and reduce claims in good time
• Fulfill the contract and close the project in accordance with contractual and in-house regulations
• Negotiate with subcontractors / partners on the basis of defined requirements and enter into compensation agreements according to the customer contract
• Define and agree the strategy to enforce / reduce / defend claims with stakeholders
• Involve the project team in the process of identifying changes and claims
• Evaluate contracts for claim relevance, ensure that they are checked by legal experts
• Implement the strategy to enforce / reduce claims
Stakeholder management
• Ensure efficient communication with all stakeholders
• Negotiate with stakeholders on requests for changes and incorporate them into contracts
• Elaborate and implement strategies to strengthen customer relations and market position
• Actively collect information on the customer and customer requirements / goals
• Involve the customer in decision-making and provide information to customers on a regular basis
Opportunity and risk management
• Identify and assess all risk factors using the available risk assessment tools throughout the project
• Ensure that the results of risk surveys and compliance risk surveys are duly taken into consideration in contracts and calculations
• Elaborate suitable strategies for minimizing (eliminating, reducing) risks
• Ensure that all risks are identified and monitored (including Compliance)
• Identify opportunities for further business with the partner(s)
• Work together with line experts to exploit opportunities
• Communicate with internal contacts across organizational borders on opportunities for further improvements
• Identify / create additional opportunities from ongoing projects
• Ensure that risks are monitored in all project phases
• Identify, assess and implement all opportunities to improve results throughout the project
• Assess risks with respect to their impact on organizational units, define measures and ensure escalation in good time
Experience & Knowledge required.
Comprehensive (deep and broad) professional know-how and experience in international railway projects.

At least 2/3 years of experience in railway signaling company as a Project Manager.
Advance technical knowledge of I/L, ERTMS, and Centralized Traffic Control systems. Main line and mass transit systems with different grades of automation
International experience. Experience in global interaction with customers/partners/providers from multiple countries.
Degree in Engineering or equivalent.
Proficient spoken and written English
Travel required

Soft Skills, Competences

Systematic use of know-how to solve complex problems. Demonstrates high professional judgement competence.. Impact on results in larger organization.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

If we all thought the same, we would never think of anything new! That’s why we recruit great minds from all walks of life. We recognise that building a diverse workforce is essential to the success of our business, therefore we encourage applications from a diverse talent pool. We welcome the opportunity to discuss flexibility requirements with our applicants to encourage agile working and innovation. Flexibility is our main benefit. We combine remote and presence work because work-life balance and wellbeing are essential for our teams. We are convinced that stay at home allow us to focus on activities that need more time for concentration and being at the office enhance our creativity collaborating and learning from others.

Siemens aboga por la igualdad de oportunidades entre mujeres y hombres, así como en la Diversidad como fuente de creatividad e innovación. Contar con diferentes tipos de talento y de experiencias nos hace ser más competitivos y estar mejor preparados para responder con éxito a las demandas de la Sociedad. Por ello, valoramos a las candidatas y a los candidatos que reflejen la Diversidad que disfrutamos en nuestra Compañía y animamos la cobertura de puestos por mujeres y hombres en ocupaciones que se encuentren subrepresentadas.

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Description
General information:

The Project Execution team is at the heart of our organization, meeting and exceeding customer expectations while helping to build a sustainable and profitable future. You will lead projects within the Transformers Business Unit.

Reporting to the Project Operations Manager you will maintain and enhance customer satisfaction by providing excellent service at all stages of the project.

The role is to be executed in our office in Cordoba (Spain).

Responsibilities:
• Leading the project team with clear guidelines, tasks and milestones, while motivating and providing feedback.
• Managing all aspects of the project to agreed-upon customer requirements and ensuring all technical, safety, quality and financial targets are met.
• Overseeing the development of project plan documents in relation to scope, budget, schedule, and risk management.
• Monitoring each stage of project implementation to ensure best practices in cost control, resource efficiency, risk... management and health, safety and the environment. Identifying, analyzing and addressing project risks, with the regular sharing of lessons learned.
• Coordinating contract negotiation and claims with customers, in collaboration with the Supply Chain and Legal functions.
• Achieving project deliverables and compliance with contract requirements.
• Building strong relationships with customers and stakeholders.
• Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background:
• A bachelor's degree in Engineering.
• More than 3 years of experience in Project Management, in a multinational environment.
• Demonstrated experience in management of project scope, cost, schedules and vendors/subcontractor Customer oriented, with excellent organization and strong communication skills.
• Fluent in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
• Current work permit valid in Spain.
• Knowledge of SAP
• French language and a PMI certification will be considered a plus

jobs_results.title: CX Project Manager (TIP2024)
jobs_results.description:
Are you a fresh graduate looking to boost your career in a dynamic and innovative multinational?

Join our Talent Incubator Program and start your career journey at Schneider Electric!

Who we are and what we do.

In Schneider Electric, we are the leading digital partner in sustainability and efficiency for businesses, communities, and individuals. Our goal is for everyone to be able to make the most of our energy and resources through the integration of processes, software, Big Data, and cutting-edge energy technologies that enable integrated management of buildings, industries, and cities.

We are part of the TOP5 in the ranking of the best companies to work for in Spain 2023, present in over 110 countries with a diverse and disruptive team of over 135,000 people.

What You Can Expect.

We have created an innovative program including many learning, training, and disruptive experiences, with tailored content regarding sustainability and digital transformation, and focusing on... launching your professional career with us.

From the first day 1 an Agile, Transformative, and Inspiring program awaits you, where you’ll combine your work hands-on work experience (being actively integrated into the day-to-day activities of your teams) with training and mentoring, and the development of a project sponsored by a member of our management committee.

We are looking for people like you, who are willing to embrace this challenge and develop the potential you have within.

Position title: CX Project Manager

Where will you work?

CS&Q is responsible for managing and improving every interaction throughout a customer's journey with Schneider. This includes understanding the customer's needs, preferences, and pain points throughout their journey, and then designing, implementing, and monitoring strategies and initiatives to enhance our overall customer experience. It also involves ensuring that products or services meet established standards and customer expectations.

This position is crucial for aligning customer experience initiatives with the company's strategic objectives. Collaborating closely with various teams and leaders provides the opportunity to influence decision-making processes that directly impact customer perception and satisfaction. Understanding customer needs and preferences enables advocating for customer-centric solutions that not only enhance the overall customer experience but also drive business growth, customer retention, and long-term loyalty. Additionally, ensuring that products or services meet established standards and customer expectations through processes to identify, address, and prevent issues in order to maintain high quality standards.

What will you do?
• Gathering and analyzing customer feedback and data to identify areas for improvement; Developing and implementing customer-centric processes across various touchpoints; Collaborating with other departments to ensure a consistent and seamless customer experience; Sharing and promoting global customer experience programs within the organization;
• Measuring and sharing customer satisfaction KPIs with the organization;
• Driving initiatives to increase customer satisfaction, retention, and value;
• Implementing corrective actions when issues are identified;
• Communicating with customers about problems and solutions;
• Training staff in quality practices;
• Advocating for the customer within the organization to ensure their needs are prioritized in decision-making.

What will you learn?

This position will allow you to develop a holistic understanding of customer experience, business, and strategic alignment, while enhancing your interpersonal and professional skills.

Communication: Improving communication skills through interactions with diverse teams, leaders, and customers. Strategic Thinking: Learning to align customer experience initiatives with the company's strategic objectives and contribute to decision-making processes. Customer-Centric Mindset: Understanding and advocating for customer needs, preferences, and solutions. Collaboration: Working closely with different teams and leaders to influence customer perception and satisfaction. Business Acumen: Gaining insights into how customer experience impacts business growth, customer retention, and long-term loyalty.

What You Bring:
• Fresh graduate in Management or Engineering
• Be able to start a 1-year program in May 2024.
• Fluent in English and Spanish, written and spoken. Portuguese is a plus.
• Analytical skills and intermediate level of Excel (Basic – Pivots and formulas, Macros - is a plus).
• Basic/intermediate level in Power Point. Knowledge of Agile methodologies and Design Thinking is a plus.
• Collaborative and curious, Active listening, Problem-solving skills, and innovative. Empathy and proactivity.

What we offer?

· An open-ended contract with a very competitive compensation package

· A unique experience specially designed for your learning and development

· The opportunity to meet others talented workers colleagues and develop your network around through activities and bootcamps

· The development of a Game Changer project with Agile methodologies.

· Depending on the position, rotations into different teams inside or outside of your department for 1 month or more

· Careers opportunities

What is the application process?

Step 1 – Online Application

Step 2 - Online recorded video interview

Step 3 – Online Competencies test

Step 4 – Online Escape Room

Step 5 - Online Interview

Places are filled on a first-come, first-served basis. We would recommend early application to avoid disappointment!.

Benefits.
• We adapt to you! :
• With our flexible schedule, you'll have the freedom to adjust your working hours to accommodate your personal needs and responsibilities.

💻 We understand the benefits of working from home. With our hybrid work plan, you can enjoy working hours from the comfort of your own home.

🏝 Need more time to relax and unwind? With our Holy Pack, you can purchase additional vacation days to recharge whenever you need it most.

📅 Celebrate holidays your way! With Floating Holidays, you can exchange public holidays for other days that better suit your plans and personal preferences.

🧘‍♂️ Need extra time to explore new experiences or focus on personal projects? With the Sabbatical Pack, you can request up to 2 months of additional unpaid leave.

💞 We value the importance of family and want to support you in all aspects of your life. Our Global Family Leave Policy provides flexible paid conditions for when you need it most, whether you're about to become a parent, need time to overcome a loss, or care for a loved one.

· We take care of you! :

📱 With access to the health and wellness platform Wellwo, you and up to 5 people of your choice can enjoy virtual medical care and 24/7 psychological support, as well as access to nutritional advice, guided classes, and much more!

🏄‍♂️ From attending dance classes to booking a hotel spa, we offer a partnership with AJ by Gympass, giving you access to a network of thousands of gyms and sports centers, so you can keep your body active in the way you prefer.

🩺 Your well-being is our priority. You'll have medical services available at your workplace for close attention to any medical needs.

· We empower you! :

🎯 With Open Talent Market, our AI-driven professional development platform, you can connect with job opportunities, projects, and mentors at Schneider Electric globally.

🤑 We offer you the opportunity to become a shareholder of Schneider Electric and share in our achievements through our employee share ownership program.

🙌 We celebrate talent and success offor all with our recognition program, where you can give and receive points for your accomplishments and redeem them for gift cards at your favorite stores.

💗 You'll have life insurance for your protection.

💰 We offer a Flexible Compensation Plan, where you can choose from a variety of options such as health insurance, meal vouchers, childcare vouchers, transportation vouchers, training, and more.

🛒 As part of our #SEGreatPeople, you'll have access to an online store with Schneider Electric products at exclusive prices and super discounts.

🎁 With Club Schneider, you'll enjoy special discounts at your favorite stores, restaurants, travel agencies, and other external services.

💚 Participate in company-sponsored volunteer programs to contribute to our community and make a positive impact in your surroundings.

Disclaimer
• We seek out and reward people for putting the customer first, being disruptingve to the status quo, embracing different perspectives, continuously learning, and acting like owners. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of the communities in which we operate. We welcome people as they are, creating an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity are seen as a real value for the company. We’re looking for people with a passion for success — on the job and beyond

Why us?

Schneider Electric is leading the digital transformation of energy management and automation. Our technologies enable the world to use energy in a safe, efficient and sustainable manner. We strive to promote a global economy that is both ecologically viable and highly productive.

€25.7bn global revenue

137 000+ employees in 100+ countries

45% of revenue from IoT

5% of revenue devoted for R&D

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled

It is the policy of Schneider Electric to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct. Concerning agencies: Schneider Electric does not accept unsolicited resumes and will not be responsible for fees related to such

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
At PayRetailers, we are committed to providing cutting-edge solutions that empower businesses to succeed in Latin America. Our collaborative and inclusive work environment encourages creativity and growth, where every employee's contribution is valued. Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with us, as we strive to make a meaningful impact on the world of payments.

We’re searching for a highly qualified professional to help us maintain our position as an innovative authority. The ideal candidate will have Project Portfolio Admin experience and is a highly resourceful Project Manager with background in Financial Services or payments.

To support and guide teams to meet and exceed business objectives ensuring the consistent achievement of all operational KPI’s across the PMO is one of this role goals, our ideal candidate has extreme attention to detail and is driven by excellence.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with project managers to ensure successful planning... execution, monitoring, and closure of projects within PayRetailers.
• Develop and maintain project documentation, including project plans, schedules, and risk management plans.
• Assist in resource allocation, tracking project milestones, and facilitating effective communication among project teams.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for JIRA administration within the PMO.
• Customize JIRA workflows, screens, fields, and reports to meet project management needs.
• Provide training and support to project teams on JIRA best practices, ensuring consistent and effective utilization.
• Communicate effectively in English to ensure clear and concise collaboration with stakeholders, both internal and external.
• Leverage previous PMO experience to contribute insights and best practices to enhance project management processes within PayRetailers.
• Actively contribute to the identification and implementation of process improvements within the PMO, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness.

Experience and Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent work experience
• Minimum of 3 years of experience leading projects (IT, banking, retail or logistics).
• Proficient in project management software tools, methodologies, and best practices JIRA is a plus
• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on reporting
• English is a must
• Experience with Global teams and with time flexibility
• Excellent analytical skills
• Strong interpersonal skills and extremely resourceful
• Excellent presentation skills
• Proven ability to solve problems creatively

What we offer:
• Competitive salary! 💶
• Opportunities to grow within a company in hypergrowth stage📉
• Additional days of holidays! ✈
• Free language classes 👨‍🏫
• Private health insurance covered by the company.🩺
• At least one day of teleworking per week 💻 #LI-Hybrid
• Free catering in the office 🥣
• Possibility to increase your net salary through our flexible retribution partner! 🍕
• Excellent work environment and good collaboration ✌️
• Free coffee/Tea and snacks from the company☕🥐

jobs_results.title: Project Management, Lead Specialist
jobs_results.description:
SUCCESSFACTORS EC-ECP PROJECT MANAGER

The Project Manager is responsible for the successful management of one or more country implementation projects eventually part of a large program with responsibility for delivering a defined section within SuccessFactors environment.

Your responsibilities:

· Manages project deliverables, scope and expectations and coordinates project progress with stakeholders and program management.

· Interfaces independently with all functional and business areas/ groups affected by the project,

· Works closely with Resource Managers to ensure adequate allocation of resources to projects is being managed

· Develops and tracks to detailed project plan, including schedules, cost estimates, resource plans, communication plans, risk mitigation plans and issue resolution plans

· Makes project decisions and recommendations to program management about schedules, prioritization, and resource allocation with input from others as needed

· Communicates and reports... status to program management and all other stakeholders e.g., Status Reports, steering input, etc.

· Provides leadership to his/her project teams

· Employs project management best practice methodologies working within a framework that includes process definition, templates, tools and Alight standards

· Coaches team members to reach common project goals/objectives

· Identifies training needs within his project team

· Managing the project budget – including the estimates created during the funding process, the on-going allocation of financial resources and the regular reporting of the state of the project financials

· Ensuring C-sat meets the agreed target, taking ownership with the AD, to drive improved customer satisfaction at project level

· Monitors the project deliverables are within Alight’s standard delivery model and deviations are identified and reported

· Driving CR’s through changes to agreed standard/contract, mitigating any commercial risk

· Driving improved project performance through continuous improvement and transformation activities

· Working with third party providers to deliver contractual commitments

Your experience:

· At least 4 years’ experience in IT-project management with background within SAP payroll implementation or SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll

· Certification in at least two SuccessFactors modules

· Willingness to travel

· Vendor management experience

· Fluent in English (written, spoken, …)

· Experience within the HR-domain

· Ideally PMP certification or similar (PRINCE2, Agile, SCRUM,…)

· Ideally HR Consulting and /or outsourcing industry experience

Your skills

· Leadership skills

· Ability to work in a multi-cultural/international environment

· Ability to interpret and prioritize multiple, potentially conflicting requirements

· Excellent presentation and influencing skills

· Strong analytical and problem solving skills

· Strong risk analysis and capacity to develop efficient and effective mitigation plans

· Outcome and target focused

· Highly commercially aware

· Pragmatic approach

· Strong financial acumen and forecast accuracy

· Clear contract understanding and scope management

· Committed to deadlines and schedule in time.

· Lead a team with moderate supervision

· Produce good quality work, delivers technical and analytical results, demonstrates value creation for smaller projects

· Contribute to proposal process independently within specified area

· Ideally leadership experience in implementing specific solutions at various customers

· implemented/led a technology solution through all project phases several times

· Combine methodology to new approaches as a response to customer needs

· Fluent English

We offer you a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

DISCLAIMER:

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job to other entities; including but not limited to subsidiaries, partners, or purchasers of Alight business units.
